description: Evans DPC helmet risk ratio (helmeted vs unhelmeted, operator / passenger pairs) under misreporting of helmet use: a fraction f of helmeted-coded survivors truly unhelmeted crossed with a fraction g of unhelmeted-coded deaths truly helmeted, with tipping fractions
population: FARS 2016-2024 motorcycles with one operator and one passenger, helmet coded helmet/none for both, known outcome
method: As belt_misreporting_two_sided_dpc, applied to the motorcycle pairs
